new.content: Skip to content Home > Everything About the Microsoft Azure Fundamentals Certification (AZ-900) Everything About the Microsoft Azure Fundamentals Certification (AZ-900) Table of Contents PriyankaS3ri July 1, 2023 12:05 pm What is Azure Fundamentals? The Azure Fundamentals certification covers many subjects and core Microsoft Azure principles. Candidates must pass the AZ-900 certification exam in order to enroll in this course. Professionals looking to confirm their knowledge and skills might choose this credential if they have a basic understanding of cloud solutions or only minimal experience using the platform. In today’s tech-driven world, a fundamental question many professionals face is, what is microsoft azure and how can it advance my career? Azure is Microsoft’s powerful cloud computing platform, and earning a certification is the best way to prove your expertise. This guide is your complete roadmap to becoming Microsoft Azure Fundamentals certified by passing the AZ-900 exam. We will cover all the essential domains, from cloud concepts to core Azure services. For those who want to accelerate their learning with expert guidance, our hands-on Microsoft Azure Training provides the in-depth knowledge and practical skills needed to ensure your success. Microsoft offers people, to begin with the azure fundamentals az 900 to boost their readiness for all upcoming certifications. The Azure Fundamentals authorization is earned after completing the Azure Fundamentals course. What is Microsoft Azure and Why Get Certified? One of the greatest ways to demonstrate your understanding of cloud fundamentals is to take the Azure Fundamentals exam. You can use Azure services, workloads, security and privacy, pricing, and support to understand better how the cloud works. The basic technical artifacts, which comprise the ideas of storage, cloud computing, students taking the exam should know networking, support, seamless application and full application development. To learn from experts check out our course Microsoft Azure Fundamentals Certification AZ-900 Who should take AZ- 900 Exam? This is a great opportunity for individuals who have used Azure services before to show that you are familiar with the essential concepts of Azure, including its many costs, services, security, support, and management. Application services, Computing, storage, networking, artificial intelligence (AI), security and Internet of Things (IoT) are just a few of the features Azure services offer. Why You Should Learn About Azure? Advantages of the Microsoft Azure Fundamentals Certification, Exam AZ-900 This certification is a good starting point for anyone looking to advance their career in the sector and work with cloud solutions and services at a beginning level. You will have the opportunity to demonstrate your familiarity with the various Microsoft Azure cloud domains, including the many cloud ideas, cloud workloads, Azure privacy, and Azure pricing, services, and security by preparing for this Microsoft Certification. Microsoft Azure is the cloud platform for over 80% of Fortune 500 firms worldwide. The financial, educational, and healthcare sectors now have higher demands for cloud platforms and services. As it lowers infrastructure and IT costs, Microsoft Azure Certification is one of the top certifications for cloud platforms. Thus, by selecting the azure az 900 , You enter a market that will likely have rapid growth over the next ten years. A Microsoft Azure certification helps you stand out from your non-certified competitors when you’re looking for work. It is one of the main justifications for selecting Azure Fundamentals as a foundational certification before delving deeper into the realm of Microsoft Azure. Connect with industry experts and get all your questions answered! Book Now Meet the industry person, to clear your doubts ! Email Phone Send Verifies your ownership of Azure Subjects The Azure certification has a lot of advantages. By completing the AZ-900 test, you have proven that you are an expert in the fundamental Azure concepts. Because you have mastered Azure, you are aware of how to prepare for challenging yet essential subjects. Your knowledge of the value of cloud services, the differences between IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS, the necessity of the Azure network, architectural security, connection, and much more has improved as a result of your Microsoft accreditation. Enroll in our Azure Certification Course today and build a career in Cloud Computing. Enhancing Your Professional Credibility with the AZ-900 Certification Nothing you’ve done to obtain your ideal position or promotion has been successful. Investing your time and money in earning a Microsoft Azure az900 certification might be better. Make sure you are ready for the required exam, the Microsoft AZ-900, and then watch as hiring managers are smitten with your resume. This certification does speak to your professionalism, which employers highly regard. So, passing the exam will give you a plethora of benefits if you want to give your professional job more credibility. Access to associate-level certification It is strongly advised that you get a foundational understanding before tackling associate certificates. This strategy will enable you to manage with more challenging issues and topics without any problems. The Microsoft AZ-900 exam will certify you in Microsoft Azure Fundamentals and allow you to pursue advanced and expert-level certifications. Delivers Unpaid Checks Did you know that earning a certification from Microsoft can help you earn more money? When evaluating your application for a position, hiring managers will take into account both your work experience and certificates. A role-based Azure certificate on your profile is another indication of professionalism. Access to the Microsoft online community is provided by it. You are introduced to the world of Azure professionals through the az 900 Microsoft Azure Fundamentals, which are instructed by experts who have followed a similar career path to your own. If you succeed on this foundational exam, you’ll gain valuable information and abilities, join the Microsoft community, and more. Being regarded as a Microsoft-certified professional isn’t an honor? Are you looking after Career Guidance from Experts? Book Now Want Free Career Counseling? Just fill in your details, and one of our expert will call you ! Email Phone Send Course Outline for AZ-900 Exam/ Az-900: Syllabus and Format The AZ-900 test syllabus places a strong emphasis on core concepts of cloud-based services in respect to Azure. Core Azure services, including storage, computing, and networking, are included. The Azure support model, and security and pricing, privacy services are also included. Usually, there are 40–60 questions with a large number of multiple-choice responses. This exam can be completed in an hour. The following table breaks down the proportion of the module’s competencies that must be acquired to pass the test: Describe cloud concepts (15-20%) Understanding the variations among public, private, and hybrid cloud models. When on-premises infrastructure or a private cloud are combined with a public cloud, a hybrid cloud results, allowing data and apps to travel back and forth between the two. Virtual machines are just one type of cloud service; there are also platform-as-a-service (PaaS), infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS), software-as-a-service (SaaS), and serverless services. Knowing the advantages of adopting Azure and the differences between capital expenditure (CapEx) and operational expenditure (OpEx), as well as terminologies like agility, availability, scalability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery Describe Core Azure Services – 15-20% You will learn about the fundamental Microsoft Azure architectural elements in this domain. Resource Groups, Regions and Region Pairs, Availability Zones, Management Groups, Subscriptions and Resource Managers are all added in terms of their advantages and ways to use them. In addition, you should be familiar with the functions and advantages of app services, virtual machines (VMs), Azure Container Instances (ACI), virtual desktops, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). This domain also encompasses ExpressRoute, Disc Storage, Container Storage, File Storage, VPN Gateways, Virtual Networks, Virtual Network Peering, and Virtual Networks. Cosmos DB, Azure Database for MySQL Azure SQL Database, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, and SQL Managed Instance are also comprised. Storage levels are also included. To become a Pro in Azure Cloud Computing check Azure Training in pune . Describe the Core Management Tools and Azure Solutions – 10-15% This class covers the essential inquiries relating to the core Azure solutions. IoT Central, IoT (Internet of Things) Hub, Azure Sphere, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, and HDInsight usage and advantages should be familiar to you. Furthermore, you should be prepared for inquiries and issues pertaining to Azure management tools, including Azure Portal, Azure PowerShell, Azure CLI, Cloud Shell and Azure Mobile App,. Explaining how to use ARM (Azure Resource Manager templates, Azure Monitor, Azure Service Health, and Azure Advisor) should come after preparation. Explain Network Security and General Security Features – 10-15% In this area, Microsoft Azure’s security tools like the Azure Security Centre are taken into account. It covers resource hygiene, policy compliance, security alerts, and secure score. Additionally, it includes Key Vault, Dedicated Hosts, and Azure Sentinel. You will also gain knowledge of network security fields such as functional ideas, NSG (Network Security Groups) defense and usage, Azure DDoS protection, and firewall protection. Explain the governance, identity, compliance, and privacy features (20-25%). In this category, you will study topics like Azure Identity Services. Conditional Access,Azure Active Directory, SSO (Single Sign-On) and MFA (multi-factor authentication are given a lot of attention. There are also inquiries about Azure Governance features. You should explain how Azure Blueprints, RBAC (Role-Based Access Control), Cloud Adoption Framework, resource locks and tags are used and function. The utilization of Microsoft’s Privacy Statement, OST (Online Service Terms), DPA (Data Protection Amendment), Azure Sovereign Regions, Azure compliance paperwork and Trust Centre are all examples of compliance and privacy resources that you should be able to articulate. Explain Azure’s service level agreements and cost management (between 10% and 15%). The final item on this list focuses on various methods of cost management and planning. You must be able to recognize the various elements influencing expenses as well as those contributing to cost savings. You should also be able to describe the operation and application of a pricing calculator and TCO. ACM (Azure Cost Management) usage and functionality should also be described. In particular, service life cycles and Azure SLAs are given special consideration in this domain. You don’t have to prepare as diligently for the test as you would for any Microsoft introductory certification exam if you have prior experience with cloud services and solutions. However, while you study for the test, industry professionals and Microsoft advise that you develop a structured strategy. Therefore, start preparing for the Azure basics AZ-900 certification right away to give your career the push it needs. Interested to begin a career in Azure? Enroll now for Azure Online Training Learning Objectives of AZ-900 Certification Training: The primary objective of AZ-900 certification course is to provide participants with fundamental understanding of Microsoft Azure. Learners gain the ability to make well-informed judgments about cloud adoption by exploring fundamental cloud ideas, Azure services, and cloud security and compliance standards. The course covers a wide spectrum of Azure services, providing insight on the Azure ecosystem’s security, compliance, privacy, and trust. This fundamental understanding not only prepares students to pursue advanced Azure certifications, but also to actively contribute to cloud efforts within their own enterprises. The course ensures a strong understanding of Azure basics, giving it a good starting point for individuals looking to traverse the complexities of cloud computing. Key Features of Azure AZ-900 Certification Training Course: The AZ-900 certification training is a foundational exploration of Microsoft Azure, imparting comprehensive knowledge in essential cloud concepts, Azure services, and cloud security principles. It serves as a gateway for learners to make informed decisions about adopting cloud technologies and actively participate in organizational cloud initiatives. Positioned as a crucial step for those navigating the complexities of cloud computing, this training cultivates a robust understanding of Azure essentials. The Azure AZ-900 Certification Training Course distinguishes itself with a holistic approach, covering vital aspects of cloud learning. Encompassing essential cloud concepts, Azure services, and security principles, the course seamlessly blends theory with hands-on practical applications through labs and real-world scenarios. Expert-led training, interactive sessions, and industry-relevant content enhance the learning experience, catering to both beginners and professionals seeking to elevate their Azure proficiency. Its flexible learning options accommodate diverse schedules, fostering a dynamic and engaging educational journey. Furthermore, the course emphasizes real-world scenarios, enabling participants to apply theoretical concepts practically through hands-on labs. Expert-led sessions ensure that learners not only grasp theoretical knowledge but also gain practical skills crucial for real-world cloud environments. The interactive nature of the course fosters a collaborative learning environment, encouraging participants to actively engage with the material and each other. With industry-relevant content aligning skills with current market demands, the course prepares graduates for challenges and opportunities in the evolving landscape of cloud computing, making it a pivotal foundation for Azure excellence. What Has Changed? The AZ-900 certification continually evolves to align with the ever-changing Azure landscape, reflecting Microsoft’s commitment to staying at the forefront of industry advancements. These updates encompass the introduction of novel Azure services, refinements to existing content, and adjustments that adhere to emerging industry best practices. Keeping abreast of these modifications is paramount, ensuring that the certification training remains pertinent and in tune with the latest trends and technologies in Azure. Remaining well-informed about these changes is facilitated by regular consultation of Microsoft’s official documentation. This invaluable resource serves as the primary conduit for the most accurate and up-to-date insights into alterations made to the AZ-900 certification content. By staying engaged with the official documentation, individuals undertaking the certification training can adapt their learning strategies and ensure that they are equipped with the latest knowledge and skills essential for success in the dynamic Azure environment. This commitment to staying current underscores the relevance and efficacy of the AZ-900 certification, making it a reliable benchmark for individuals seeking a foundational understanding of Microsoft Azure. How to Register for AZ-900 Exam: Registering for the AZ-900 exam is a straightforward process facilitated through the official Microsoft Learn website. Prospective candidates can initiate the registration by navigating to the dedicated AZ-900 exam page, where they will discover comprehensive instructions to guide them seamlessly through the registration procedure. A prerequisite for registration is a Microsoft account, easily created if not already possessed. The exam registration provides candidates with the flexibility to choose between two options: selecting an on-site test center or opting for the convenience of an online proctored exam. This choice caters to individual preferences and ensures accessibility for candidates worldwide. Critical steps in the registration process include a thorough review of exam details, confirmation of eligibility, and the completion of the payment process. Emphasizing the importance of adequate preparation, candidates are encouraged to utilize the available study resources and practice exams before scheduling the AZ-900 exam. This proactive approach contributes to a more confident and successful exam experience, aligning with Microsoft’s commitment to providing a streamlined and accessible certification process for individuals seeking proficiency in Microsoft Azure fundamentals. Exam Retake Policy: Microsoft’s AZ-900 exam retake policy is designed with fairness and flexibility, recognizing the diverse learning curves of candidates. In the event of not passing the exam on the initial attempt, individuals are granted the opportunity for a swift retake after a minimal waiting period of at least 24 hours. This immediate reattempt allows candidates to capitalize on their recent exam experience, quickly address any identified weaknesses, and fortify their understanding for a more successful outcome. For subsequent retakes, a 14-day waiting period is imposed, maintaining a balanced approach that encourages strategic preparation and thorough review. This deliberate waiting period serves as a valuable interval for candidates to delve deeper into the exam content, address areas of improvement, and enhance their overall readiness. The retake policy, with its considerate waiting periods, not only accommodates diverse learning styles but also empowers candidates to approach the AZ-900 certification journey strategically. This policy underscores Microsoft’s commitment to candidate success by providing a supportive framework for skill reinforcement and knowledge enhancement. new.content: Skip to content Home > Top Express.js Interview Questions and Answers to Help You Succeed Top Express.js Interview Questions and Answers to Help You Succeed ExpressJS is the most used and popular server-side scripting tool to create everything from an easy-grip line program to compound enterprise-level web applications with equal ease. This is the only reason why many organizations demand certified ExpressJS developers for providing the management of the entire server-side. Table of Contents PriyankaS3ri June 9, 2021 7:12 pm ExpressJS is the most used and popular server-side scripting tool to create everything from an easy-grip line program to compound enterprise-level web applications with equal ease. This is the only reason why many organizations demand certified ExpressJS developers for providing the management of the entire server-side. As a result, ExpressJS opens many career opportunities for candidates who wish to have a secure job in this field. Express.js is the backbone of countless Node.js applications, making it an essential skill for modern web developers. When preparing for technical interviews, you can expect to face a variety of express interview questions designed to test your practical knowledge of the framework. A deep understanding of Express is a core component for any full-stack developer, especially those specializing in the MEAN stack. For developers looking to master the entire ecosystem, enrolling in a comprehensive Mean Course provides the end-to-end expertise employers seek. This guide will arm you with the top express.js interview questions and answers to ensure you’re ready to succeed. Suppose you are an aspirant who is wishing to get the ExpressJS developer job. In that case, you should buckle up your preparation and start with the ExpressJS interview questions for getting the job post at the most famous organization quickly. This blog is framed to help the candidates with the top interview question on ExpressJS. Let’s start From Middleware to Routing: Essential Express Interview Questions 1- Describe the meaning of ExpressJS A free, open-source, lightweight Node js-based application framework is the ExpressJS. ExpressJS was written in JavaScript by TJ Holowaychuk in 2010; it is formulated to develop web-related applications and APIs. 2- Mention various features of ExpressJS The given points state the features of ExpressJS ● ExpressJS has middleware that responds to HTTP and restful requests. ● With ExpressJS, the routing table can be defined for performing numerous HTTP operations. ● ExpressJS renders HTML path thickness solely based upon arguments and templates. ● ExpressJS is known for this thin layer and high performance. ● ExpressJS has adequate support for RDBMS and NoSQL databases. ● ExpressJS can organize web applications to MVC infrastructure. ● ExpressJS manages all the tasks from routes for rendering views and performing HTTP requests. 3- State the numerous ways to allow CORS in ExpressJS Cross-origin resource sharing is the device that allows the restriction of resources that will be requested from different domains. ExpressJS allows CORS as through. ● CORS allows setting a single header through res.setheader() ● For setting up multiple headers, res.header() OR res.set() will be used. ● The module of express CORS. 4- Define scaffolding of ExpressJS Scaffolding is the process through which the creation of the skeleton of any application is possible. Scaffolding can be done in mainly two ways which are ● Express application generator ● Yeoman 5- Explain routing and it’s working in ExpressJS Determining how the application responds to the client request in the particular endpoint with a URL and specific HTTP request method is said as the routing. The router has one or more handler functions through which the route executed is matched. The syntax of the route is app.METHOD(PATH, HANDLER) Interested to begin a career in ExpressJS? Enroll now for MEAN Stack Training in Pune . 6- Define middleware in ExpressJS The function is invoked through the express routing layer before the handler of the final request. Middleware in ExpressJS can perform numerous tasks like ● The execution of any code. ● It can make any changes in the request and response objects. ● It can end the cycle of response requests. ● Middleware can call the following middleware function in the stack. 7- State the meaning of database integration in ExpressJS Database integration can add the capability of connecting databases to the applications of ExpressJS in just a matter of loading in the NodeJS driver for the database in the application. ExpressJS supports numerous RDBMS and NoSQL database like ● MongoDB ● MySQL ● Oracle ● PostgreSQL ● SQL server ● SQLite 8- Mention the steps for setting ExpressJS application The following steps given under can utilizes the setting up of the ExpressJS application ● Require a folder with a constant name as the project name will be created. ● Require the file name package.json within the folder. ● The command npm. The install will be run in electronic communication.npm.install libraries of the packages. ● The server.js file is created. ● The file named router is made in the package, which consists of the folder name index.js ● The creation of the app in the package has an index.html file. Are you looking after Career Guidance from Experts? Book Now Want Free Career Counseling? Just fill in your details, and one of our expert will call you ! Email Phone Send 9- State the usage of the following in ExpressJS Next is responsible for passing management with the consecutive matching route. It operates to pass management to one of the route handlers. This argument needs to be omitted, which is beneficial whenever you get the series of handlers. 10- Mention the features of the ExpressJS framework Numerous core features of the ExpressJS are ● ExpressJS frameworks allow setting the middleware for responding to HTTP requests. ● It will define the routing table through which it can work as per the HTTP method and URL. ● The express framework supports dynamic HTML pages. 11- What is the method of getting variables in the ExpressJS of the GET method? var express = require(‘express’); var app=express(); app.get(‘/’, function(req, res){ /*req have all the values**/ res.send(‘id.+ req.query.id); }); app.listen(3000); 12- Give the syntax of removing debugging from express app var io= require(‘socket.io’).listen(app, {log:false}); io.set(‘log level’,1); 13- Give the syntax of the “next” parameter in ExpressJS app.get(‘/userdetails/:id?; function(req, res, next){ }) req and res represent the request and responding objects Next passes control the next matching route. 14- Which function arguments are available in ExpressJS route handlers? The list of argument available under ExpressJS is ● Req for requesting the objects. ● Res for responding to the objects. ● Next for employing to pass management to 1 of the route handlers. However, this argument is optional in the case of ExpressJS. 15- What is the procedure of configuring properties of express application? Under ExpressJS, mainly two methods are followed for configuring the properties as For env process ● The name of the file env is created within the project. ● The properties will be there in the .env file. ● The properties can be employed under the server in ExpressJS. For require js process ● The name of the file config.json.js created in the config folder within the project. ● The properties are config which is to be present in the config.json file. ● The access of accustomed will be the config.json file. 16- Give the syntax for enabling debugging under express application In Unix operating system, debugging can be availed through $ DEBUG=express:* node index.js Whereas in Windows, the syntax will be set DEBUG=express:* & node index.js 17- How to authenticate users? It is one more authentication opinionated area that express doesn’t venture to. Authentication can be used for any authentication scheme. 18- State the name of the template engine which ExpressJS support The template engine, which has the signature, can easily be covered by ExpressJS like path, locals, and callback. 19- State the reasons for using ExpressJS Various reasons for choosing ExpressJS are ● ExpressJS framework is lighter in weight than any web application framework. ● ExpressJS helps in organizing web applications to MVC architecture on the server-side. 20- Describe the modules used in ExpressJS The framework of ExpressJS has no notion of the database. It is the concept that is left up to a third-party module. It can interface with any nearby data. Numerous modules used in ExpressJS are ● HTTP ● util ● fs ● URL ● query string ● stream ● zlib Want to Book A Free Expert Guidance Session? Book Now Get FREE career counselling from Experts ! Email Phone Send 21- Mention the uses of ExpressJS ExpressJS helps in developing scalable network programming efficiently. Many more reasons for using ExpressJS are ● ExpressJS is fast. ● ExpressJS doesn’t block easily. ● ExpressJS offers a unified programming language and data type. ● Under ExpressJS, everything is asynchronous. ● ExpressJS has high concurrency. 22- Is ExpressJS the fantastic platform for CPU-heavy applications? ExpressJS is beneficial in creating server-side applications; CPU-enabled applications don’t suit ExpressJS. The CPU-heavy execution paves the way for blocking requests and pushing the threads to critical situations. 23- Give the purpose of the ExpressJS package ExpressJS are the flexible NodeJS application framework that provides various features for developing web and mobile applications. It is used in managing the flow of information between routers and servers in server-side applications. It has numerous features because of its long-lasting features. Learn more at 3RI Technologies 24- State the advantages of ExpressJS The benefits of ExpressJS are given under ● ExpressJS is very fast because it is built on a google V8 engine. ● ExpressJS framework is asynchronous in which it never waits for API. ● ExpressJS is highly scalable than other frameworks. ● ExpressJS offers an open-source community to add excellent modules. ● ExpressJS outputs the data in chunks. 25- Define error first callback in ExpressJS It is also known as the error back, which gives the error and data. ExpressJS takes numerous arguments out of which one is an error and others are objects. It offers many benefits as it is consistent, leads to adoption, and has no data reference. 26- Define LTS release of ExpressJS LTS can also be said as Long-term support, which is applied to relate the lines supported and maintained through the ExpressJS project for the period of extension. Mainly two varieties of LTS are there ● Active LTS, which are retained and updated. ● The line of maintenance was nearing its end of the line and maintained for a shorter time. 27- Give the difference between spawn() and fork() Spawn Fork It is designed for running the commands The instance of spawn runs the new instance of Google V8 It doesn’t execute different code with the process It can create numerous workers which run on the same code. child_process.spawn creates the new process of the command The case of spawn is used in the creation of the child process. It creates the streaming interface between parent and child process It creates the communication channel between parent and child process It is more useful in operations like data streaming, file streaming of files, etc. It is used in JSON and data messaging. 28- Give the example of streaming in ExpressJS var readStream = fs.createReadStream( ‘data.txt’); readStream.on(‘data’, function(chunk) { data += chunk; }); 29- Describe crypto It is the type of module used in ExpressJS that is further used in cryptography, including wrappers under open SSL hash, HMAC, sign, decipher cypher, and function verification. 30- Give the usage of DNS in ExpressJS The module named DNS is used in resolving the name. DNS is provided through an operating system that is used for an actual DNS lookup. It is not required for memorizing the IP address as a DNS server that converts domain and subdomain. 31- Describe the security mechanism of ExpressJS The security mechanism of ExpressJS is ● Authorization of codes ● Certification of modules ● Screening curated register ● Updates regulations 32- Define LTS version LTS version of ExpressJS is the type of release that receives critical fixes, performance step up, and security updates. In addition, LTS versions have the support of 1.5 years, focusing on the security and stability of the application. 33- Give the assert working in ExpressJS The word assert is used in the writing of tests in ExpressJS. The feedback will only be given if the test cases fail. For testing invariants, the modules will provide the assertion tests. The assertion is used internally in ExpressJS, but this testing will let you use it in other web applications. Connect with industry experts and get all your questions answered! Book Now Meet the industry person, to clear your doubts ! Email Phone Send 34- What is the use of NODE_ENV? Whenever the production stage in the ExpressJS project starts, it promotes using the principle NODE_ENV variable for flagging it. Thus, whenever the Node env is set for production, the application will be running 2 to 3 times faster. 35- Define Punycode It can be defined as the encoding syntax of ExpressJS, which is helping in converting the Unicode string of characters into ASCII. Punycode is the hostnames that ASCII codes and Unicode can only comprehend. It was bundled up with the default package in the recent versions of the code. 36- List various types of middleware Numerous types of middleware are ● Application-level middleware ● Router level middleware ● Error handling middleware ● Built-in middleware ● Third-party middleware 37- Define stub These are the stub or functions which are used for stimulating the component behaviour. Also, stubs provide the answers to the function during the test cases. 38- Describe the meaning of CLI The CLI is primarily known as the command-line interface. CLI is the utility or program where users type the command to perform the actions or run a script instead of clicking on the screen. Some CLI includes ● Bash on Linux ● Terminal of MAC ● Command prompt or power shell ● Shell/command line Check out MERN Stack Training in Pune . Enroll now! 39- Define V8 engine It is google’s high-performance open-source Javascript engine which is written in mainly C++ and google. In addition, V8 implements ECMAS script, which is specified on ECMA 262 and runs on Windows 7. 40- Mention the purpose of require() It is used for the inclusion of modules from the external files in ExpressJS. Require() is the easiest way of including a module in the express. It requires a function that takes the parameter string for the location of the file. Require() to read the entire javascript file, which executes the file and then returns the exports. 41- Give the distinction between the cluster and child_process module Cluster Child_process Is the module which has the function set and property to help the developers for forking the processes which they can take the advantage of the multi-core. It can be easily spun on ExpressJS which can communicate with each other in the messaging system. 42- Name the varieties of a web application that can be built on ExpressJS Web applications like single-page, double-page, and hybrid pages can be developed with ExpressJS. 43- Point the difference between put and patch Put Patch Put has the embedded entity in the modified version of the resources which are deposited on the real server Under patch, the information regarding the modification of the original server which holds the time of resourcing for producing the new version is present. At the time of quotation, people need to forwarding the full payload as request Only need to send the parameter at the time of update. 44- State the reasons for using Zlib in ExpressJS The comprehensive library of cross-platform data is zlib. Zlib can be used in ExpressJS for thread pools, HTTPS requests, and compression responses. But for using the zlib, it’s necessary to install the express zlib package. 45- Define closures It is the function defined in another scope that has access to the variable within the outside range. Thus, the variables present on a global level can be made locally with the closures. 46- State the meaning of revealing module pattern and also give the syntax This function is just similar to the module pattern. IT Exposes only the properties and procedures which are returned via the object. The syntax for the revealing module is var greeting = ‘Hello world.’ function greet() { console.log(greeting) } module.exports = { greet: greet } 47- Give the example of callback function function callback(err, results// usually we’ll check for the errors before handling results if(err) { //handle error somehow and return } //no error, perform standard callback handling } 48- Define JIT and state its relation with ExpressJS It exists for Just in time. JIT is the program compiler used to send the bytecode to the processes with converting it to instruction. After the writing of the program finishes, the compiler will source the language statement to byte code instead of compiling it all over. With ExpressJS, JIT has improved the execution speed of the code. ExpressJS takes the source coding and converts it to the code of runtime. Claim your free expert counseling session today! new.title: Fake Experience Certificates Can Ruin Your Career: Know the Risks Before It's Too Late
new.meta_description: Using a fake experience certificate might seem like a shortcut, but it can lead to legal trouble, job bans, and career damage. Learn the consequences from a Trusted Training Institute.
h1: Why Fake Experience Certificates Are a Risky Career MoveHow fake experience certificates ruin your career?
new.content: Skip to content Home > Why Fake Experience Certificates Are a Risky Career MoveHow fake experience certificates ruin your career? Why Fake Experience Certificates Are a Risky Career MoveHow fake experience certificates ruin your career? According to law, fake certificates are a criminal offense. Either you get it for yourself or issue it to someone who asks you to do so. Most of the fake resources don't mention their full identity. It is because they know that what they are doing is not legally acceptable. Table of Contents PriyankaS3ri June 29, 2022 1:42 pm According to law, fake certificates are a criminal offense. Either you get it for yourself or issue it to someone who asks you to do so. Most of the fake resources don’t mention their full identity. It is because they know that what they are doing is not legally acceptable. In the recruitment industry, there are many challenges that a recruiter has to face. But one major obstacle that comes their way is finding the right or real candidate for the suitable job. It is more frustrating than anything else when you find out that the candidate you hired is fake. There are lots of candidates who tend to show fake experience certificate to get into a job. In this competitive world, these things happen frequently. There are lots of companies that are providing fake certificates. These fake authorities tend to do so to make money, just for some earning, they ruin some deserving candidates’ careers. Sometimes to get into a job, people make fake experience letter . They got hired based on those certificates, but they don’t have the technical knowledge or work experience at all. Some candidates with all those skills could not get hired because they have no experience. They were keen to learn that experience by doing jobs in their relevant field but failed to get it. In today’s competitive job market, the temptation to use a fake experience certificate or rely on fake experience letter providers can seem like a fast track to a dream job. But this shortcut often leads to career-ending consequences — from blacklisting to legal punishment. Employers are more vigilant than ever, and background checks can expose any discrepancies. Instead of risking your future, focus on real skill-building and verifiable credentials. Learn and grow with a Trusted Training Institute that empowers your career the right way — with integrity, knowledge, and recognized certifications. Are you looking after Career Guidance from Experts? Book Now Want Free Career Counseling? Just fill in your details, and one of our expert will call you ! Email Phone Send Nowadays, many renowned companies are familiar with these fake work experience certificate tricks to find out the real ones. They make different stages to get hired in their company. The recruitment department follows various numbers of procedures to select a candidate. First, they start with initial screening, where the recruiter talks to prospective candidates. After that, they check their professional experience. If too many skill sets are mentioned in their resume, it is generally to grab the attention of recruiters. So they ask candidates more about their expertise and to be more specific on their resume. Recruiters ask them questions like technologies used, project, team size, reporting manager, their previous company, training details, the size of the respective department, etc. Companies can now ask for legal documents such as their relieving letters and photo id proof issued by the previous company. If they have experience on a piece of paper, they can’t provide you with the vast details asked by the recruiter. If we want to define a fake experience certificate , all in all, we can say that a job is certified by the candidate, which they never did. The details are false, from the employment period to the issuing company itself does not exist in this real world. Well, there are three different types of fake experience certificates. The first one is those in which company and employee do not exist on paper. It means that some people edit others’ experience certificates and put their names on them. The second type is the one that people buy from an existing company. We can say that it exists on paper but does not operate—the cost of making a fake experience certificate legal action may depend upon their profile and what they need. The third type of fake experience certificate is linked with fake training institutes. There are lots of companies that provide fake professional training etc. These types are merely based on the incidents we faced; it could have more types also which are invisible. The purpose of writing an experience letter is different for everyone. So whenever you are hiring for a sales profile, then be very careful. The Legal and Career Consequences of Using Fake Experience Documents There is an incident which I have to face in my life where I have to choose the right candidate for the required post. This candidate passed all levels of the interview in our company, including the written test, ,HR round and Hiring manager. When resume came to my office along with all previous interviewer’s feedback. I looked at all the interviewers’ feedback; it seemed all good. Then come to the resume part, where he mentioned he had a couple of years of experience on his resume. He said he has been working for that company since he graduated. I asked for his company name, making me curious to know all the details. So I quickly went to google to search about the company he mentioned in his resume, but the website did not look professional. I wonder if they had any employees or not in real life. I have doubts, so to clarify that I went to the MCA21 master data website by the ministry of corporate affairs to search for the search company name, but I found nothing. My question was, when did you complete your engineering. He gave his answer as per his resume. I asked him where is your office. He gave me the details, but they did not exist according to sources. He cleared all other stages with his abilities, but those fake experience certificates make him guilty of misleading the company. If he came to our office as a fresher still, we could consider him for the job, but fake certificates make all his existence doubtful. Some editing apps which are available online also play an important role in this field. With the help of these, anyone can edit documents according to their needs. The question may arise in the mind can i get a fake experience certificate easily. If someone is able to get the job based on those fake certificates but in the work field you will not be able to do that then reality will come out and you may be fired from the job. Sometimes it may lead you to prison if the evidence is totally against you. Most companies prefer employers with experience, but they are also looking for freshers to mold them according to the company’s needs. Contrary to the above, you spend the same time getting some original skills which will be helpful in future. There is certain fake experience certificate punishment for this offense. According to IPC sections 465 and 471, if someone is found guilty of this offense, the punishment for fake experience certificate in India with imprisonment of 2 years with a fine. In some cases, companies blacklist the fraud employee so that he cannot apply again to the same company. Faking a resume will not make you qualified either. Some candidates think that they can get away with lying on resumes here and there. In some cases, they originally have 1 year of experience but aggravate their expertise to strengthen their resume. But it is not that easy to fool such higher authorities , when the background inspection is held, they go in brief into the matter and ensure that every document the candidates provides is valid. It is such lame thought to think in this way. Every company looks at candidates’ talent, not only what you have written on the piece of paper. Why would someone want to take such a risk when your career is at stake. It’s better to groom yourself rather than lie on your resume. Read Blog : Problems You May Face If You Use A Fake Experience Certificate To Get A Job In IT Sector According to a survey, there is a rise in lying on the resume after the recession. People are so desperate to get work, and for that, they are taking the wrong paths. Not only deserving candidates but companies are also suffering. These fake certificate holders ruined their reputation too. Those who possess such fake degrees are charged under sections 420 (cheating), 467 (forgery of valuable security), 468 ( forgery of cheating), 471 ( using as genuine a forged document), and 109/120B ( abetment of criminal conspiracy) of IPC ( Indian penal code). This fake experience certificate is a crime that discourages those who have worked hard to reach a senior level, whereas such fake people try to do so without much effort. Even if you used a renowned company name to complete your motive, that company could file a case against you in a court of law. Claim your free expert counseling session today! Getting a fake experience on a piece of paper will not guarantee you anything. You will always be at risk of losing your job. The consequences of these fake experience certificates are terrible. It’s not just unethical but humiliating and self-esteem damaging also. As a fresher, don’t lose hope. There are a lot of companies who can hire you. Understanding the Roles of Front-End and Back-End Developers The most fundamental definition of web development is creating a website for the web. The more technical aspects of a webpage, such as coding, typography, and scripts to generate features and capabilities, are often referred to as web development. The developers’ sole goal is the various components of web design, such as designing the layout, scripting, and implementing software and visuals. What is Universal Rendering? Universal rendering, also known as isomorphic rendering, refers to a web development technique that allows rendering the same code on both the client and server sides of an application. Web applications have traditionally implemented either client-side rendering (CSR) or server-side rendering (SSR). Whereas CSR uses JavaScript to render content dynamically on the client side, SSR renders the original HTML content on the server before sending it to the client’s browser. With universal rendering, the benefits of SSR and CSR are merged. It involves rendering initial content on the server to provide faster page loads and better Search Engine Optimization (SEO), while still allowing dynamic interactions on the client side. This approach enhances performance by serving pre-rendered content to users, improving SEO by delivering crawlable content to search engine bots, and maintaining interactivity by allowing client-side JavaScript to take over once the page is loaded. What Different Types of Web Development Exist? The lines between the three distinct career pathways , back end vs. front end vs. full stack web developer , might occasionally feel blurry in the technological world. Back-end developers are engaged with statistics, design, and the webpage. Front-end programmers aid in the building of the user interface. Cross-Browser Compatibility: Achieving consistency across different web browsers is imperative for frontend developers. Algorithms are a popular approach for problem-solving, whilst Data Structures are numerous methods for data storage, and Full Stack Developers should be conversant with both fundamental concepts. Is a full stack software engineer a software Engineer ? The answer is not a simple yes or no but rather depends on various factors such as the individual’s skill set, responsibilities, and the context of the job role. So, on the whole a full stack software engineer is someone who hold the extensive knowledge in both the both front-end and back-end programming skills. They are efficient enough to execute all kinds of tasks pertaining to the web development. This inculcates designing user interfaces, putting server-side logic into practice, handling databases, and making sure that different web application components integrate seamlessly. Full stack developers are adept at languages and frameworks such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, and lot many more. Whereas a Software Engineer is a broader term that encompasses professionals involved in designing, building, and testing of the software or applications. They are a professional who maintain the software products effectively. They are highly professional on both the system related software along with the embedded systems. In addition to this they are skilled in web development as well as building the mobile applications. A Software engineer holds deep & immense knowledge of programming languages, Algos, DS [Data Structure], and software product development style. 2. What is the meaning of Full stack in Full stack Development? The term “full stack” refers to the complete set of technology and expertise needed to create a web application’s front-end (client-side) and back-end (server-side). Being “full stack” means having the ability to oversee all aspects of web development. They are professionals who handles the project of software development right from designing the software to implementing the user interfaces to managing data and all the operational task pertaining to the server-side. Full Stack Developers can design and develop web apps from start to finish thanks to their extensive skill set. A Full Stack Developers are a highly skilled software developer who are competent in working with all layers of the application. In terms of back end they mostly work on the server-side logic, databases, and infrastructure, While working from front end, handle the user interface and user experience (UI/UX) with high efficiency. This includes understanding and working with technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, front-end frameworks/libraries, server-side languages, databases, web servers, APIs, and more. Understanding the Stack: The term “stack” refers to the collection of technologies and tools used to develop a web application. A full stack developer can manage every facet of web development with ease since they are skilled in dealing with both the client-side (or “front-end stack”) and server-side (or “back-end stack”). Front-end Stack: The structure of web pages is defined by HTML. CSS facilitates the web pages with thousands of styles, layout, colors, and typography. JavaScript provides functionality and interactivity to the website pages. Front-end Frameworks such as React.js or Angular. These framework streamline the front-end development and enhance productivity. Back-end Stack: Programming Languages, like JavaScript (Node.js), Python, Ruby, Java, or PHP, used for server-side logic. Web Servers, like Express.js (Node.js), Django (Python), Ruby on Rails (Ruby), Spring (Java), or Laravel (PHP), which oversee HTTP requests and responses. Databases like: MySQL, MongoDB. These databases are mainly considered to store and oversee the application data. APIs guarantee effective interaction between an application’s front-end and back-end parts. 3. Who are full stack developer and what are the works they perform? Full stack software developer is well-informed and has boundless knowledge in both the front-end and back-end development. Unlike specialists who focus solely on either front-end or back-end technologies, a full stack developer possesses a broad skill set encompassing various programming languages, and frameworks necessary to create and maintain complete web applications. Working on web applications’ front end and back end is part of full stack development. Full stack developers have immense and deep knowledge in HTML, CSS, JavaScript for front-end development. They are skilled in server-side technologies like Node.js, Python, Ruby on Rails for back-end development. Full stack developers manage databases using systems like MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB. They understand DevOps practices for efficient deployment and maintenance. Full stack developers excel in problem-solving and learn new tools and technologies quickly. Developing and maintaining web applications from conception to deployment is the responsibilities of full stack development. They implement front-end functionality using frameworks like React, Angular, or Vue.js. Full stack developers build scalable server-side components with frameworks such as Express.js, Django, or Flask. Collaboration and effective communication are essential as the full stack developer work closely with cross-functional teams to meet the project goals. 4. Enlist the Job Roles and Responsibilities of a Full Stack Software Developers. Here are the Job Roles and Responsibilities of the Full Stack Developer: Development of Front-end Interfaces: Using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, full stack developers create and build user interfaces to guarantee a smooth and simple user experience. Implementation of Back-end Functionality: To manage data processing, business logic, and authentication, they create server-side logic and APIs. Database Management: Full stack developers design and maintain databases, such as schema design, querying, and optimization for performance. Integration of Components: They facilitate seamless data flow and communication by ensuring flawless integration between the application’s front-end and back-end modules. Testing and Debugging: Full stack developers ensure that that the application is resilient and credible, identify and fix vulnerabilities in their code, and test it rigorously. Deployment and Maintenance: They deploy applications to production environments, monitor performance, and address any issues or updates as needed to ensure the continued smooth operation of the application. 5. Enlist all the important tech-skills required to grow a career as a full Stack Developer. A comprehensive skill set is required for full stack developers in order to be competent in both the front- and back-end development, alongside soft skills and presentational skills for efficient and effective along with essential soft skills for effective teamwork. Below are the key skills required to excel in this multifaceted role: Proficiency in Front-end Technologies: . Mastery of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for developing synergistic and receptive user interfaces. . Understanding of the front-end frameworks such as: React, or Angular. Expertise in Back-end Development: . Immense knowledge of the server-side programming languages like: Node.js, Python, Java for implementing server logic. . React guarantees a responsive and dynamic user experience by efficiently managing the UI state. Server-Side: Express and Node.js Node.js and the Express.js framework are used on the server side to build a solid backend. When creating RESTful APIs, Express makes handling routing, middleware, and HTTP requests easier. MongoDB database NoSQL database MongoDB uses a flexible format comparable to JSON for storing and retrieving data. Developers can deal with data in a way that best suits the application’s requirements thanks to its smooth integration with the Node.js backend. Communication Through API requests, React.js on the client side interacts with the Node.js backend. Express.js communicates with the MongoDB database to process these requests and return the relevant data to the React.js frontend when necessary. Higher salary package The Same Things About Full Stack and MEAN Stack First, let’s discuss what Full Stack and MEAN Stack have in common. To begin, they both make a person a full-stack coder. You can easily work on both client- and server-side projects once you know how to do either.Learning many programming languages for both the front end and the back end is essential for full-stack developers. You only need to learn a few frameworks for MEAN stack development for the same thing. There is a lot of desire for both of these types of skills. MEAN stack developers are better at working on JavaScript projects, but full-stack coders know more about everything. Because of this, businesses should hire both of them. Among full-stack’s branches is MEAN stack. Learning the MEAN stack correctly is essential if you want to work as a full-stack programmer. The Distinction Between MEAN Stack vs. MERN S. NO. MEAN Stack MERN Stack 1. Angular, Express, Node.js, and MongoDB make up its tech stack. React, Express, Node.js, and MongoDB make up its tech stack. 2. It’s a framework for JavaScript. The JS library is freely available. 3. Typescript is the language used for it. It employs JSX or JavaScript. 4. It provides increased productivity. It has a low productivity level. 5. It has a steep learning curve. It provides significantly superior documentation. 6. It facilitates code management and rendering. It makes rendering smoother. 7. Data flows through it in both directions. It only allows data to go in one direction. 8. It is not compatible with mobile apps. Mobile applications are supported. Popularity of the MEAN Stack vs MERN Stack Choosing a well-known and well-liked technology stack is something you should do for your web development project. However, as many developers would be aware of a popular stack technology, your chances of finding adaptable developers increase if you choose it. In actuality, MEAN vs. MERN Stack has gained popularity because of the contrast between Angular and React. Over time, the AngularJS framework has become more and more well-known for creating responsive online applications.However, React’s impact on front-end development has been revolutionary in recent years. According to a HackerRank Developer Skills report, 30% of developers polled said they were aware of Angular, making it the most widely used web framework in the developer community. React, however, came in second place because 26% of developers claimed to be familiar with the framework. Nevertheless, things changed in 2019. According to the same survey, thirty percent of developers were keen to master React technology. This reached the widely read one. However, the proportion of Angular developers fell to 20%, suggesting that React is now more popular than Angular. Regarding the current situation, 74.5% of developers polled said they would use React instead, making it the most popular and well-liked framework. However, Angular is only in ninth place because of its 57.6% developer population. Angular and React are, to put it briefly, both widely recognized and popular. Hiring React developers instead of Angular developers becomes considerably simpler, though. Compare (Table): MERN Stack vs. Full Stack vs. MEAN Stack Full Stack lets you make any kind of app your business needs, while MEAN and MERN Stack are special technologies for making JavaScript-based apps that work well and can be scaled up or down easily. Provides various ready-to-use features Needs more libraries to handle requests that are similar. The average salary paid in India for a full-stack developer is around 6.95 per annum approx. And that for a mean-stack developer is about 9.1 per annum approx. Takeaway Understanding the exact difference between Mean stack and Full stack development, you can decide on your own whether you want to go for which development side – according to your skills and interests. There is no such a thing that which is better, mean Stack or full-Stack? If you are interested in one and want to pursue your career in that, you can go ahead with that. new.content: Skip to content Home > Python Introduction and Basic Concepts for Beginners Python Introduction and Basic Concepts for Beginners Purpose of this Blog This blog is designed for complete beginners, learners, and working professionals who wish to start learning Python from the ground up. It addresses the common challenge of not knowing how to begin by simplifying the most important concepts into easy-to-follow explanations. You will understand what variables, data types, functions, and control flow mean and how they interact with each other. By mastering these basics, you will be able to create your first simple and working scripts, reduce common programming mistakes, and establish a strong base to confidently handle more advanced coding challenges in the future. Table of Contents madan October 4, 2023 1:35 pm Introduction Python is a widely used, high-level programming language valued for its clarity and ease of use. The syntax of Python is intentionally simple and human-readable, which makes it an ideal option for beginners starting their coding journey. At the same time, it is highly flexible and supports numerous applications such as web development, data analysis, machine learning, and scientific computing. The basic concepts of Python refer to the essential elements required to create programs using the Python programming language. These fundamentals include variables used to store information, data types such as strings and numbers, and control structures such as loops and conditional statements which guide program execution. Gaining a strong understanding of these core concepts is a crucial starting point for anyone aiming to develop applications, automate processes, or work with data, as they serve as the foundation for advanced programming logic and real-world projects. If you are at the beginning of your coding journey, having a clear overview is essential: Coding Essentials for Beginners: Start Your Programming Journey with Confidence. Python is one of the most beginner-friendly and powerful programming languages used in web development, automation, AI, and more. This guide covers the introduction of Python, along with basic concepts of Python like variables, data types, and loops in Python. Whether you’re just starting out or need to sharpen your core Python knowledge, understanding these fundamental Python skills is essential. Designed for newcomers, this overview helps you grasp key Python concepts step by step. Ready to start coding with confidence? Enroll in expert-led Python training in Pune at 3RI Technologies and kickstart your career today. Introduction of Python: Why It’s So Popular Understanding Fundamentals of Python Programming Before diving into the world of Python programming, it is essential that you understand the fundamental concepts. These are the fundamental concepts that will let you write code that is both efficient and effective. Let’s look more closely at each of these concepts: Eager to stay competitive in your career? Check out the Python Training in Pune. What can Python do? Python is widely used on servers to build dynamic web applications. It can support existing software to create and automate effective workflows. Python is capable of connecting to database systems, as well as reading, writing, and modifying files. It is widely used to handle massive datasets and conduct complex mathematical calculations. Python supports fast prototyping and is equally suitable for developing scalable, production-level software. Why Python? Python runs smoothly across multiple platforms, including Windows, macOS, Linux, and Raspberry Pi. The syntax is clean and similar to English, making it easy to read and understand. Python allows developers to write clean and effective programs using fewer lines of code compared to many other languages. Because Python uses an interpreter, code can be executed immediately after writing, which speeds up testing and prototyping. Python supports various programming styles, such as procedural, object-oriented, and functional programming. Good to know The latest major release of Python is Python 3, and this tutorial will be based on that version. In this guide, Python code will be written using a text editor. However, Python can also be developed using Integrated Development Environments (IDEs) such as Thonny, PyCharm, NetBeans, or Eclipse, which are especially helpful when working with larger Python projects. 1. Variables and Data Types Dynamic Typing Python’s dynamic typing allows variables to be defined without explicitly defining their data types. Python code is readable and clear due to its flexibility. However, it’s important to note that Python still enforces type safety at runtime. Here is further information about Python’s dynamic typing: Variable Declaration In Python, the data type does not need to be explicitly declared when creating a variable. The type is assigned by the value given to the variable. For example: x = 10 # x is an integer name = “Alice” # name is a string value = 3.14 # value is a float is_valid = True # is_valid is a boolean Python identifies the data type based on the values you assign. This flexibility allows you to change the content of a variable freely: x = 10 # x is an integer x = “Hello” # x is now a string Type Inference Python performs type inference at runtime, which means that it determines the data type of a variable while the program is executing. This allows for dynamic and flexible code execution. For example: x = 10 y = “20” result = x + y # Python dynamically converts x to a string and performs string concatenation In the above example, Python recognizes that x is an integer and y is a string, and it dynamically converts x to a string to perform the concatenation. Type Conversion You can convert between different data types using built-in functions like int(), float(), str(), and bool(). num_str = “42” num_int = int(num_str) Are you looking after Career Guidance from Experts? Book Now Want Free Career Counseling? Just fill in your details, and one of our expert will call you ! Email Phone Send Function Arguments and Return Types Dynamic typing extends to function arguments and return types. Python functions can accept arguments of various types, and their behavior can adapt accordingly. Similarly, functions can return values of different types based on the specific execution context. def add(a, b): return a + b result1 = add(3, 5) # result1 is an integer (8) result2 = add(“Hello, “, “World!”) # result2 is a string (“Hello, World!”) Python’s dynamic typing makes it possible to create flexible functions that can handle a variety of data types, enabling code reuse. Explore further with our Python Web Development Course to deepen your knowledge and skills. Polymorphism Dynamic typing contributes to Python’s support for polymorphism. Due to polymorphism, many types of objects can be treated as though they are all of the same fundamental type. This concept enables you to write flexible and extensible code. class Dog: def speak(self): return “Woof!” class Cat: def speak(self): return “Meow!” def animal_sound(animal): return animal.speak() dog = Dog() cat = Cat() sound1 = animal_sound(dog) # Calls Dog’s speak method sound2 = animal_sound(cat) # Calls Cat’s speak method In the example above, the animal_sound function can work with both Dog and Cat objects because of Python’s dynamic typing and support for polymorphism. 2. Control Structures Conditional Statements Conditional statements let you execute different code blocks based on specific conditions. Python facilitates readable and understandable code by utilizing indentation for identifying code blocks. temperature = 23 if temperature > 30: print(“It is hot outside!”) elif temperature > 20: print(“It’ is a pleasant day.”) else: print(“It’s chilly.”) Loops Python offers two main types of loops: for and while. These loops enable you to iterate through sequences or execute code until a condition is met. # Using a for loop for i in range(5): print(i) # Using a while loop count = 0 while count < 5: print(count) count += 1 3. Functions Function Parameters and Return Values Functions have the ability to take parameters (or arguments) as input and output values. You can have functions with multiple parameters and even functions with default parameter values. def add(a, b): return a + b result = add(3, 4) Scope and Global Variables Understanding variable scope is crucial. Variables defined inside of functions are local to the specific function, but variables specified outside of functions are global. Within a function, the global keyword must be used to change a global variable. x = 10 def modify_global(): global x x = 20 modify_global() print(x) # Outputs 20 Take Action! Book a Free Expert Session Book Now Get Free Career Counseling from Experts ! Email Phone Send 4. Data Structures Data structures are essential tools in computer science and programming that allow you to efficiently organize, store, and operate with data. In addition to a large selection of pre-built data structures, Python also lets you create your own. Here is a list of some of the most well-liked data structures in Python: Lists Lists are one of the most versatile and widely used data structures in Python. They contain items of many data types and have organized as collections of items. As lists are mutable, you can change their contents. # Creating a list my_list = [1, 2, 3, “apple”, “banana”] # Accessing elements print(my_list[0]) # Output: 1 print(my_list[-1]) # Output: “banana” # Modifying elements my_list[2] = 4 # Adding elements my_list.append(“cherry”) # Removing elements my_list.remove(2) Tuples Tuples are just like Lists in that they cannot have their contents modified once they have been created, while being immutable. They are often used to store related data as a single unit. # Creating a tuple my_tuple = (1, 2, 3, “apple”, “banana”) # Accessing elements print(my_tuple[0]) # Output: 1 # Tuples are immutable; the following line would raise an error: # my_tuple[2] = 4 Sets Sets are collections of unique elements with no specific order. They are often used to carry out tasks like testing membership or deleting duplicates from a list. # Creating a set my_set = {1, 2, 3, “apple”, “banana”} # Adding elements my_set.add(“cherry”) # Removing elements my_set.remove(2) Looking forward to becoming a Python Developer? Then get certified with Python Online Training Dictionaries Dictionaries are collections of key-value pairs that are not ordered. When each value is associated with a unique key, they can be utilized to efficiently store and retrieve data. # Creating a dictionary my_dict = {“name”: “Alice”, “age”: 30, “city”: “New York”} # Accessing values by keys print(my_dict[“name”]) # Output: “Alice” # Modifying values my_dict[“age”] = 31 # Adding new key-value pairs my_dict[“country”] = “USA” # Removing key-value pairs del my_dict[“city”] Strings Strings are sequences of characters and are treated as immutable in Python. They support a wide range of string manipulation operations. # Creating a string my_string = “Hello, World!” # Accessing characters print(my_string[0]) # Output: “H” # String slicing print(my_string[7:12]) # Output: “World” # String concatenation new_string = my_string + ” How are you?” # String methods my_string.upper() my_string.replace(“Hello”, “Hi”) Lists of Lists (Nested Lists) Python allows you to create nested data structures, where one data structure is nested inside another. Lists of lists are a common example of this, where each element in the outer list is a list itself. # Creating a list of lists matrix = [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6], [7, 8, 9]] # Accessing elements print(matrix[1][2]) # Output: 6 Stacks and Queues Stacks and queues are abstract data types that can be implemented using lists. Stacks follow the Last-In-First-Out (LIFO) concept, while First-In-First-Out (FIFO) concept is followed by Queues. # Implementing a stack using a list stack = [] stack.append(1) stack.append(2) stack.pop() # Removes and returns the top element (2) # Implementing a queue using a list from collections import deque queue = deque() queue.append(1) queue.append(2) queue.popleft() # Removes and returns the front element (1) Sets and Dictionaries as Data Structures Sets and dictionaries can also be used as data structures to solve specific problems efficiently. For example, sets are used to find unique elements in a collection, and dictionaries are used for fast data retrieval by keys. # Using a set to find unique elements my_list = [1, 2, 2, 3, 4, 4, 5] unique_elements = set(my_list) # Using a dictionary for efficient data retrieval student_grades = {“Alice”: 95, “Bob”: 89, “Charlie”: 78} alice_grade = student_grades[“Alice”] Custom Data Structures Python allows you to define custom data structures by creating classes. You can define the behavior and attributes of your data structure to suit your specific needs. class MyLinkedList: def __init__(self): self.head = None # Define methods to manipulate the linked list # … # Creating an instance of a custom data structure my_linked_list = MyLinkedList() 5. Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) The Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) paradigm places a strong emphasis on organizing code into reusable, independent pieces known as objects. Python is a versatile and object-oriented programming language, and it encourages developers to follow OOP principles to build modular and maintainable software. Here’s a comprehensive look at OOP in Python: Learn more at Full Stack Online Course Objects and Classes In Python, everything is an object. An object is a standalone component that contains data (attributes) and functionality (methods). Classes have instances that are objects. An object’s structure and behavior are specified by a class, which serves as a blueprint or template. An object is created by instantiating a class. # Define a simple class class Dog: def __init__(self, name): self.name = name def bark(self): return f”{self.name} says Woof!” # Create instances of the Dog class dog1 = Dog(“Buddy”) dog2 = Dog(“Charlie”) # Access attributes and call methods print(dog1.name) # Output: “Buddy” print(dog2.bark()) # Output: “Charlie says Woof!” Claim your free expert counseling session today!
